scripts.build: pnpm --filter babel-plugin-jsx-dom-expressions run build && pnpm --filter @dom-expressions/compiler run build:debug
scripts.test: pnpm --filter babel-plugin-jsx-dom-expressions run build && pnpm --filter @dom-expressions/compiler run test
scripts.parity: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @dom-expressions/compiler run parity:1x
scripts.parity:baseline: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @dom-expressions/compiler run parity:1x:update
scripts.parity:diff: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @dom-expressions/compiler run parity:1x:diff
